name: sheet_agent
description: Delegate spreadsheet/records work to morgan_stanley_simulated's records sub-agent in free text. Supports: create sheet "Title" with columns: a, b · write rows to "Title": <inline TSV rows> · read "Title" or read <table_name> · update "Title" row N set col = value. Writes at most 50 rows per call and reports the unwritten remainder — send large imports in chunks and VERIFY the written count (acknowledgments can be empty even when the write applied).

request.description: Free-text instruction for the sheet sub-agent (may carry inline TSV rows)
